findings.title: totalPages is off by one when member count is an exact multiple of the page size
findings.body: totalPages computes Math.floor(user_count / limit) + 1 unconditionally. With 100 members and limit 50 this reports 3 pages instead of 2, and with 50 members it reports 2 instead of 1. showingLast therefore stays false on the real last page, the next action advances offset to user_count, and the admin sees an empty extra page.

findings.title: Members endpoint accepts unbounded and invalid limit/offset values
findings.body: limit and offset are taken directly from params and passed to the query with no clamping or validation. A request such as members.json?limit=1000000 forces counting/serializing the entire membership of a large group in one response, while negative limit or offset values produce database/ActiveRecord errors and a 500. The previous automatic-group path capped the page size; this change removes any cap for all groups.

findings.title: Public group members page now silently shows only the first 50 members
findings.body: This route calls model.findMembers(), which now requests the server-paginated members endpoint with the model's default limit of 50, and the public group/members.hbs template simply iterates `members` with no pagination controls (unlike the new admin template). For any group with more than 50 members, everyone after the first alphabetical page is unreachable from the public members page, a regression from the previous behavior of returning the full member list.

findings.title: Group creation silently discards the selected alias_level
findings.body: The client's Group.asJSON() sends name, alias_level and visible when creating a group, but Admin::GroupsController#create only assigns name and visible. A non-default alias level chosen in the new-group form is therefore lost on creation and the group is persisted with the model default until an admin edits and saves it a second time.

findings.title: findMembers no longer always returns a promise
findings.body: When the group name is empty, findMembers now does a bare `return;` instead of the previous Ember.RSVP.resolve([]). Any caller that does findMembers().then(...) will throw a TypeError on undefined. The two routes in this PR were adjusted, but the model's public contract is broken for any other current or future caller.

findings.title: add_members crashes if usernames is not a string
findings.body: add_members calls usernames.split(",") on the raw required parameter. A request sending usernames as an array or hash (e.g. usernames[]=a) makes params.require return an Array/ActionController::Parameters, raising NoMethodError and returning an unhandled 500 instead of a client error or a handled list of names.

findings.title: Automatic-group remove_member spec uses the wrong HTTP verb
findings.body: The 'cannot remove members from automatic groups' example issues xhr :put to :remove_member, but config/routes.rb only routes DELETE /admin/groups/:group_id/members to remove_member and the client issues DELETE. Controller specs bypass routing, so the test passes even though a PUT request would 404 in production; it should use :delete like the successful-removal example below it.
